text:
maria: CI smoke red on h100 pool, started ~10:12 UTC. multiple shards failing with OOM + driver probe hung. stack shows nvml timeout + XID 79 on warmup. logs attached here: 

maria: ```
[2025-01-07T10:12:03Z] gpu0: nvml: Timeout waiting for response
[2025-01-07T10:12:04Z] kernel: NVRM: GPU at PCI:0000:81:00: GPU HANG: ecode 0x54
[2025-01-07T10:12:05Z] python: RuntimeError: CUDA error: invalid device function
```

maria: quick triage ask: can someone kick a rerun on h100-ci-03 and check host driver vs container CUDA compatibility? suspect driver bump from last deploy. :eyes:

ahmed: on it, pinging ci-bot to requeue the failed shard only. also can we get host nvidia-smi and container `nvcc --version` output?

ci-bot: requeued job 8712093 (shard 4/8) to h100-ci-03. rerun id: rerun-8712093. will post results when done.

jonathan: if it's driver probe hung + invalid device function, that smells like host driver <-> container runtime mismatch. last driver bump PR was abc123 (driver 550 -> 555). worth bisecting that commit.

lina: I can run a quick local repro on an h100 host in staging. which commit should I pin for the container?

maria: pin to main@f4a2d8 (the build used in failing run). host on h100-ci-03 reports driver 555.0, container CUDA 12.1.

ahmed: can you paste `modinfo nvidia` and `dmesg | tail -n 50` from h100-ci-03 if you have access, @sre-oncall?

sre-oncall: looking now. node shows a recent kernel module reload at 09:58 UTC and a couple of XID 79 spikes. I'm going to taint the node and move other jobs off until we confirm.

ci-bot: rerun finished: rerun-8712093 -> FAILED (same OOM + invalid device function). full logs uploaded: link: https://ci.internal/reruns/rerun-8712093/logs

lina: grabbing the logs. interesting: warmup batch uses model shard with fused kernels. stacktrace shows `launcher::launch_kernel` failing on `attention_fused`.

jonathan: try a temporary workaround: force non-fused kernels via ENV VAR `REDWOOD_USE_FUSED_OPS=0` in the runner and requeue. if that passes, we narrow to kernel/path selection issue.

maria: good plan. I've kicked a debug rerun with REDWOOD_USE_FUSED_OPS=0 -> rerun-8712100.

ci-bot: rerun-8712100 queued to h100-ci-04 (different host)

ahmed: also adding a note to the driver-bump PR to hold rollouts until we confirm. tagging @infra-team for rollback option.

sre-oncall: dmesg snippet from h100-ci-03: ```
[09:58:12] nvidia: module unloaded
[09:58:12] nvidia: module loaded (version 555.0)
[10:12:03] NVRM: Xid (79): GPU hang during context switch
```

ci-bot: rerun-8712100 finished -> PASSED (warmup success).

maria: confirmed. PASS when fused ops disabled. so likely a kernel/fused-op path problem coupled with driver 555.0.

jonathan: can someone bisect the driver bump (abc123) to find exact regression? if we isolate kernel codepath, we can file with upstream vendor and pin fallback.

lina: I'll start a quick bisect: build pairs with driver 550 vs 555 and run minimal attention fused test. posting results in ~30m.

ahmed: thanks. I'll keep the driver-rollout paused. also adding a temporary patch to set REDWOOD_USE_FUSED_OPS=0 in CI h100 matrix until we have a vendor fix or verified rollback.

maria: filing a short incident note in #incidents with summary and link to rerun logs. tagging stakeholders. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: removing taint on h100-ci-03 after low load. will monitor for further XID spikes.

lina: bisect early result: repro fails with driver 555.0 and fused enabled, passes on 550.0. narrowing commit to driver packaging changes, sending notes to vendor.

maria: awesome, thanks everyone. follow-ups: infra to hold rollout, infra/qa to coordinate vendor bug, eng-ml to keep REDWOOD_USE_FUSED_OPS=0 in h100 CI for next 48h. closing thread after vendor ack.
